pendulum.command.already_running: A script is already running. Use /pendulum abort first.
pendulum.baritone.not_installed: Baritone is not installed. Please install Baritone to use baritone.* functions. https://github.com/cabaletta/baritone
pendulum.help.title: === Pendulum Minecraft API ===
pendulum.help.movement: Movement: forward(ticks?), back(ticks?), left(ticks?), right(ticks?), stop() — no arg = hold, with arg = move N ticks
pendulum.help.rotation: Rotation: lookAt(x,y,z), setYaw(y), setPitch(p), getYaw(), getPitch()
pendulum.help.interaction: Interaction: use(), attack(), breakBlock(), breakBlockAt(x,y,z), swapHands(), drop(), dropAll(), pickBlock()
pendulum.help.gui: GUI: closeGui(), isGuiOpen(), getGuiTitle(), clickSlot(id), clickSlotRight(id)
pendulum.help.baritone: Baritone object (br/baritone): br.help() for full list
pendulum.help.baritone.title: === Baritone API ===
pendulum.help.baritone.pathfinding: Pathfinding: goto(x,y,z), come(), axis(), thisWay(), surface()
pendulum.help.baritone.control: Control: stop(), pause(), resume(), isActive(), isPaused()
pendulum.config.title: Pendulum Config
pendulum.config.break_timeout.tooltip: Maximum ticks to wait for a block to break (20 ticks = 1 second).
pendulum.config.max_script_runtime.toolt: Maximum time in seconds a script can run before being auto-aborted. 0 = unlimited.
pendulum.config.ray_trace_distance.toolt: Maximum distance for breakBlock() ray tracing.
pendulum.config.tick_interval_ms.tooltip: Milliseconds to sleep between tick checks (higher = less CPU, less accurate).
pendulum.config.sync_use_attack.tooltip: Whether use() and attack() wait for the action to complete before returning.
pendulum.config.log_js_errors.tooltip: Print JavaScript errors to the Minecraft log.
pendulum.config.mcp_enabled.tooltip: Start the MCP JSON-RPC server when the game launches.
pendulum.config.mcp_port.tooltip: TCP port for the MCP server (1024-65535).
pendulum.mcp.already_running: MCP server is already running on port %s.
pendulum.mcp.status_running: MCP server is running on port %s.
pendulum.config.allow_execute_command.to: Allow scripts to run client commands (e.g. /gamemode, /tp). Default: enabled.
pendulum.config.allow_say.tooltip: Allow scripts to send chat messages.
